jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking Senior Infrastructure Engineers to design, build, and operate the high\-performance virtual networking dataplane that underpins OCI gateway services. In this role, you will develop major C and C\+\+ features for packet processing, routing, network address translation, gateway functionality, and security\-policy enforcement. You will optimize CPU and memory efficiency, concurrency, latency, and throughput for production systems operating at cloud scale. You will partner with networking, control\-plane, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to build fault\-tolerant distributed systems with strong tenant isolation and safe deployment practices. The role includes end\-to\-end feature ownership: architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, observability, on\-call support, incident response, and continuous operational improvement. Experience with fast dataplane technologies such as DPDK, VirtIO, eBPF, XDP, SR\-IOV, SmartNICs, or userspace packet\-processing frameworks is especially valuable. **Key Responsibilities:** **Dataplane Scalability and Performance** * Implement and enhance C and C\+\+ components for OCI’s virtual networking dataplane, including routing, network address translation, network gateways, and security\-policy enforcement. * Build packet\-processing features that support scalable, multi\-tenant cloud networking with guidance from senior engineers. * Profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory usage, concurrency, latency, and throughput in large\-scale production environments. * Contribute to fast dataplane development using technologies such as DPDK, VirtIO, Linux networking, SR\-IOV, SmartNICs, or userspace packet\-processing frameworks. * Develop and maintain unit, integration, system, performance, and scale tests. * Participate in design and code reviews, applying established patterns for performance, correctness, and maintainability. **Reliability and Availability** * Implement fault\-tolerant networking components that handle failures, maintenance events, and software updates with minimal customer impact. * Contribute to resilient designs using health checks, retries, timeouts, graceful draining, failover, and recovery mechanisms. * Develop fault\-injection, brownout, and recovery tests to validate service behavior. * Support staged deployments, automated validation, monitoring, rollback, and recovery procedures. **Observability and Operational Excellence** * Build and maintain service metrics, alarms, dashboards, telemetry, canaries, and operational health checks. * Diagnose Linux, networking, performance, and production issues using logs, metrics, packet captures, traces, profilers, and debugging tools. * Create and improve runbooks, diagnostic tools, and automation for common operational issues. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action follow\-through. **Security and Multi\-Tenant Isolation** * Apply established security and tenant\-isolation practices to dataplane and gateway features. * Help identify and remediate security, reliability, and operational risks. * Maintain technical documentation and follow applicable security, compliance, and change\-management processes. **Automation and Change Management** * Maintain automation and infrastructure\-as\-code used to build, test, deploy, and operate the service. * Implement automated checks and safeguards for configuration changes, software releases, and rollback procedures. Own assigned features through implementation, testing, deployment, production validation, and support. * **Core Responsibilities:** **Planning and Execution** * Plan and deliver assigned work with limited supervision, identifying dependencies and risks early. * Manage priorities and adjust execution as requirements, timelines, or production needs change. * Communicate progress, blockers, and technical decisions clearly. **Collaboration and Partnership** * Work closely with networking, control\-plane, infrastructure, security, and operations teams. * Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident reviews, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Document technical decisions and contribute to team standards and best practices. **Problem Solving** * Independently troubleshoot standard and moderately complex issues using established engineering practices. * Analyze data from logs, metrics, traces, packet captures, and tests to identify root causes. * Escalate complex cross\-service issues appropriately while contributing to their resolution. **Continuous Learning and Improvement** * Build expertise in C/C\+\+, systems programming, cloud networking, Linux, and high\-performance dataplane technologies. * Seek feedback and apply it to improve technical and operational skills. * Identify practical opportunities to improve testing, tooling, deployment, observability, and team workflows.

jobs.title: AI Engineer | Digital Products & AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. *PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life* **Job Description** This practice is built for the way enterprise software *actually* gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses. As an AI Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to shape, design and build those solutions. Working alongside Product Strategists and Data Engineers, you'll take products from discovery through deployment, combining technical depth with a practical understanding of what clients need to achieve. On some engagements, we continue to run what we've built, giving you the opportunity to stay close to the product and see the impact of your work long after go\-live. This is a hands\-on engineering role. Most of the code here is written by agents. That does not make this a supervision job. It moves the engineering upstream, where strong engineering judgment becomes even more important. You'll write code, review agent\-generated outputs, and shape the architecture, controls and acceptance criteria that determine whether a solution succeeds in production. Requirements do not always arrive fully formed, and part of the role is helping define the problem while continuing to move delivery forward. **As part of the Digital Products \& AI team, you can expect to:** * Architect the elements that determine whether AI solutions succeed in production, including tool selection, memory and context management, guardrail design, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and deploy the technical components that power agentic systems, including retrieval pipelines, MCP services and integrations, and the systems that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data and processes. * Modernize platforms and applications around current business needs, rebuilding where necessary rather than simply moving legacy functionality onto newer technology. * Design security and operational resilience into solutions from the start, including access controls, identity management, deployment guardrails, and oversight of automated actions. * Break down complex problems into deliverable components, helping shape scope, sequencing, and implementation approaches that enable rapid delivery. * Create reusable patterns, skills, and tooling that strengthen future engagements and contribute to the growth of the capability. **Qualifications** You have a track record of designing, building, and delivering complex technology solutions in production environments. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work. **To be successful, you'll have:** * **Engineering foundations** + Experience building and operating production software. Client\-facing technical delivery experience is expected at senior levels. + Strong software engineering skills, ideally including Python and TypeScript. + Experience designing and delivering cloud\-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. * **AI engineering** + Hands\-on experience building AI applications and agent\-based systems in production. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies, and the judgment to know when an orchestration layer earns its complexity. + Experience building retrieval\-enabled systems and working with technologies such as pgvector, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch, with an understanding of the trade\-offs between retrieval quality, latency, and cost. * **Enterprise delivery** + Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data platforms, APIs, identity providers, and MCP\-enabled services. + Strong technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while working directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, balancing delivery speed with quality, security, and long\-term maintainability. **Ideally, you'll also bring:** * Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or time as a technical founder. * Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries. * Experience building reusable platforms, tooling, or AI solutions in regulated environments. **Additional Information** Hybrid working \- our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work. Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self. Find out more about Life at PA here. We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well\-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits: * Group medical insurance * Health Savings Account with company match * Teladoc and informed Nurse line resources * Long term care plan * Group dental insurance * Vision plan * 401(k) Savings Plan with company profit sharing contribution * Commuter and Parking tax\-savings benefit * 15 days paid vacation days with the opportunity to buy five additional days * 10 paid Holidays plus 10 paid sick days * Company and Voluntary income protection benefits * Gym and health incentive reimbursement * Pet and legal insurance Plans * Employee Assistance Plan * Annual performance\-based bonus We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief veteran status, or other by any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer - Snowflake & dbt Cloud
jobs.description: Are you looking for a forward focus environment where you are continually challenged, and the atmosphere is affirming? Do you want to be a part of a team where you are often out of your comfort zone, but you wake up excited to go to work each day? How about a place where people are growing because they desire change and growth is modeled and expected? **WHO WE ARE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is a '**USA Today Top Workplace**' and one of the largest trailer leasing and rental companies in the nation, specializing in long\-term leasing and short\-term rental services for over\-the\-road vans, flatbeds, refrigerated equipment and chassis with an inventory of 70,000 trailers and a growing network of locations across the United States. At Premier you will find an environment where you are seen, heard and valued. Join us and experience what it means to live a culture of C.A.R.E! **JOB SCOPE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is building its next\-generation Enterprise Data Platform to support its continued growth as part of a hybrid data modernization plan. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an experienced Snowflake builder. You will help design and implement a greenfield Snowflake environment, establish the engineering practices surrounding it, and deliver governed, production\-grade data products supporting reporting, operational integrations, APIs, and future AI workloads. We are looking for someone who has built and operated this kind of platform before, brings practical lessons from prior implementations, takes ownership, and constructively challenges technical assumptions. As the platform and team grow, you will establish the standards and patterns future data engineers will follow. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Greenfield Platform Build:** Partner with Data Leadership to design and implement a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt Cloud, managed ingestion and CDC tooling, appropriate custom integrations, and GitHub\-based workflows. * **Engineering Standards \& Operating Model:** Establish repeatable practices for environments, Git workflows, modular development, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment controls, rollback, documentation, monitoring, access, and production support. * **Data Architecture \& Modeling:** Build a layered architecture spanning raw ingestion, conformed enterprise models, and published marts or data products. Design canonical models that standardize core business entities, definitions, relationships, and rules. * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Design and operate resilient ingestion patterns for SQL Server, ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, REST APIs, files, and semi\-structured data using managed CDC and ingestion platforms alongside custom integrations where appropriate. * **Legacy Decoupling:** Work with Data Leadership and the SQL Server team to profile legacy sources, inventory dependencies, identify data\-quality risks, reconcile existing outputs, and migrate consumers from direct source\-system access to governed data products. * **Quality, Reliability \& Observability:** Establish automated testing, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, schema\-change controls, CDC\-lag monitoring, alerting, failure handling, retry and replay patterns, runbooks, and production support expectations. * **Security, Cost \& Performance:** Design Snowflake environments, roles, service accounts, access patterns, workload isolation, monitoring, and consumption controls that support least privilege, auditability, performance, and responsible cloud spend. * **Data Delivery:** Publish governed data products for Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, internal and customer\-facing APIs, custom applications, and a DBA\-managed SQL Server serving layer for approved legacy and latency\-sensitive consumers. * **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration:** Serve as the technical lead for the platform, owning technical quality, production readiness, design patterns, documentation, and platform stability while collaborating with Data Leadership and the data team, as well as infrastructure, security, and application teams. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS:** * **Proven Greenfield Snowflake Experience:** 7\+ years of progressive data engineering or data platform experience, including substantial hands\-on responsibility for at least one production greenfield Snowflake implementation or major platform modernization into Snowflake. * **Deep Snowflake Experience:** Practical expertise with Snowflake architecture, warehouse and workload design, RBAC, security, cost governance, performance tuning, semi\-structured data, monitoring, and production operations. * **dbt Cloud Expertise:** Hands\-on experience establishing and operating dbt Cloud with GitHub for modular transformation development, testing, lineage, documentation, environment management, CI, and production deployment. * **Production Pipeline Ownership:** Experience designing and operating resilient ingestion, CDC, transformation, and delivery pipelines, including schema drift, freshness, reconciliation, failure recovery, retry, replay, and incident response. * **Data Modeling \& Quality:** Expertise designing conformed enterprise models, dimensional marts, and durable canonical data products supported by automated testing and data\-quality controls. * **Software Engineering Practices:** Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Git and GitHub workflows, automated testing, code review, modular development, CI/CD, and controlled production releases. * **Security, Governance \& Cost Discipline:** Experience establishing practical access controls, environment separation, service\-account and secrets patterns, auditability, production\-change controls, and consumption monitoring. * **Pragmatic Technical Leadership:** A hands\-on builder who communicates tradeoffs clearly, challenges assumptions constructively, and takes ownership of reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production delivery. * **Location:** Must be based in, or willing to commute to, the Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week. **PREFERRRED EXPERIENCE:** * Experience migrating or decoupling consumers from legacy Microsoft SQL Server environments into Snowflake. * Experience with SQL Server CDC and near\-real\-time ingestion. * Experience with Dynamics GP, enterprise CRM systems, or similarly complex operational platforms. * Experience with Azure Blob Storage, semi\-structured documents, images, or other unstructured data. * Experience with reverse ETL, operational data delivery, customer\-facing data APIs, or application integrations. * Experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish a growing data engineering function. **TECH STACK:** * **Primary Platform:** Snowflake * **Transformation, Testing \& Lineage:** dbt Cloud * **Source Control \& CI/CD:** GitHub, GitHub Actions, dbt Cloud CI * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Managed ingestion platform, SQL Server CDC, REST APIs, files, and custom integrations * **Primary Sources:** SQL Server, Dynamics GP (ERP), CRM, SaaS applications, Azure Blob Storage, APIs, and semi\-structured data * **Consumers:** Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, APIs, custom applications, SQL Server serving layers, and future AI and machine\-learning workloads

jobs.title: Data Security Sales Specialist-Commercial
jobs.description: **About Us:** Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people. **How We Work:** At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values: **Bold** in how we dream and innovate **Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities **Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes **Visionary** in future focused problem\-solving **Exceptional** in execution and impact Department Overview The Data Security Specialist team at Proofpoint is an exciting, fast\-growing organization comprised of passionate, talented professionals dedicated to helping customers protect their most valuable asset: Data. As one of Proofpoint’s key growth engines, the team supports a world\-class customer base and drives adoption of an industry\-leading Data Security platform and solutions spanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management, SaaS Data Protection, and Data Security for AI capabilities. As organizations increasingly embrace Generative AI and AI\-powered business workflows, the Data Security team plays a critical role in helping customers innovate securely while maintaining visibility, governance, and control over sensitive information. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Security Sales Specialist to align with our **Commercial Central and East** team. Must reside Utah or Pittsburg, PA Reporting to the Director of Data Security Specialists, you will partner closely with Proofpoint’s core sales organization to drive growth across the region. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will help customers develop and execute modern data security strategies that address evolving risks across cloud, SaaS, insider threats, and AI\-driven environments. As organizations accelerate the adoption of AI, you will guide customers in protecting sensitive data, reducing AI\-related risk, and enabling innovation securely through Proofpoint’s Data Security platform. In this role, you will act as a strategic Data Security Specialist, partnering with account teams to develop, influence, and advance data security opportunities. You will bring consultative expertise to customer conversations, collaborate with partners, sales leadership, and technical teams, and help align Proofpoint’s data security capabilities to customer priorities, risk reduction goals, and measurable business outcomes. Your Day\-to\-Day * Build strong relationships across customer organizations and within Proofpoint to drive opportunities from discovery through close. * Partner with core account teams to expand Proofpoint’s Data Security footprint within existing customers while identifying and capturing net\-new opportunities. * Lead customers and core sellers through the Data Security sales cycle utilizing industry best practices and Proofpoint’s proven methodologies for evaluating modern data security platforms. * Act as a strategic advisor to customers navigating data security challenges related to cloud transformation, insider risk, regulatory compliance, and AI adoption. * Drive conversations around Data Security for AI, helping organizations secure sensitive data used by Generative AI applications, AI copilots, SaaS AI capabilities, and emerging agentic workflows. * Collaborate with Sales Engineers to develop account strategies, deliver impactful demonstrations, facilitate workshops, and execute proof\-of\-value and proof\-of\-concept programs. * Partner with the channel ecosystem to expand market share and accelerate Data Security growth across the region. * Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on pipeline generation, customer expansion, competitive displacement, and long\-term platform adoption. * Drive ongoing enablement of Proofpoint’s Data Security portfolio across the sales organization through training sessions, office hours, sales updates, role plays, and territory\-specific support. * Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity progression through Salesforce, and related sales tools. What You Bring to the Team * Proven success selling Data Security solutions into Enterprise and Strategic accounts. * Experience with one or more of the following solution areas: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management (IRM/ITM), Cloud and SaaS Data Protection, Security Service Edge (SSE)/SASE, AI Security, AI Governance, or AI Risk Management. * Strong understanding of modern data security challenges across cloud, SaaS, AI, and hybrid enterprise environments. * Ability to engage executive stakeholders and articulate both business value and technical differentiation. * Exceptional discovery, presentation, relationship\-building, and consultative selling skills. * Strong strategic account planning, territory management, and forecasting capabilities. * Ability to thrive in a matrixed environment and build trust across cross\-functional stakeholders. **Why Proofpoint?** At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us: * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits * Career success on your terms * Flexible work environment * Annual wellness and community outreach days * Always on recognition for your contributions * Global collaboration and networking opportunities **Our Culture:** Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Proton is building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution, embedded in the workflows that move nearly every physical product on the planet. Distribution is a $9 trillion industry running on software that has been stuck for decades. We unify CRM, PIM, eCommerce AI, and Order \& Quote Entry AI into one platform with one data layer and one AI brain, so reps spend their time on customer relationships instead of data entry. We have been building AI into distribution since 2018, long before it became an industry buzzword. That head start matters, and we've only deepened the investment: in 2025 we shipped the first AI assistant embedded in a distribution CRM and launched a complete agentic product in our PIM offering. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. Everyone here is a builder who owns problems end to end and ships AI\-native software faster than anyone else in the category. The median Proton customer reports 3x profit return per dollar spent and an extra day of sales per rep per month. Hundreds of distributors run on Proton, from family\-owned shops to publicly\-traded enterprises. We're backed by Felicis Ventures and Battery Ventures. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring a Product Manager to own product domains end to end. Reporting to the VP of Product, you'll lead a multi\-functional squad at the intersection of AI capability and real distributor workflows, turning our positioning advantage into compounding product differentiation. End to end means further than it usually does. You inherit a problem space rather than a backlog: work out where the real value sits across hundreds of distributors, ship in tight cycles with design partners keeping you honest, prove the thing works in production, then drive adoption across the base and make it something sales can sell without you. There is no handoff point where the domain stops being yours. **Location:** Cambridge, MA. Hybrid, 3 days a week in our Harvard Square office. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own your domain from fuzzy to growth.** Take an ambiguous problem space through discovery, definition, build, launch, adoption, and revenue. You are responsible for the outcome. * **Get onsite, constantly.** Distributors work in warehouses and on sales floors. Onsite visits, shadowing sessions, and discovery calls are how you learn the domain, and the best calls come from standing next to a rep. Our product people know their users by name. * **Run genuinely iterative development with customers in the loop.** Think big, ship small, put working software in front of real users early, and let what you learn reset the next cycle. Design the feedback loop deliberately rather than waiting for feedback to arrive. * **Build hands\-on with engineering, design, and data science** to ship features and agentic workflows, and to make sure the surrounding UX lets a user act on what AI surfaces. * **Own adoption, not just launch.** Run alphas and betas, stay close through the first rollouts, then push adoption across the installed base and watch where it stalls and why. * **Enable GTM.** Give sales and CS the positioning, proof, and training they need. Join customer and prospect calls, show the product yourself when it helps, and make sure what you built is sellable and supportable without you in the room. **What You'll Need to Succeed** ------------------------------- * **Product and startup experience.** At least 2 years managing features end\-to\-end through the SDLC. Early\-stage startup experience (Seed through B or C) is a plus. * **Real agile experience, and the judgment to adapt it.** You've worked inside traditional scrum, know what those rituals were for, and can run a tight iterative loop with customers rather than a release calendar. You've shipped something incomplete on purpose because it was the fastest way to learn. * **Technical and AI collaboration.** You've built alongside engineers and data scientists to deploy AI\-centric features at scale, and you're fluent enough to hold your own with senior engineers on data models, APIs, and service boundaries. * **Daily, hands\-on use of AI in your own practice.** Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, used to ship real work rather than generate artifacts. You can say concretely how you structure context and how you check what comes back. * **Customer\-facing range.** You're as comfortable in a warehouse aisle with a rep as on a call with a VP of Sales, and you can carry a room in front of a prospect. You'd rather be with a user than briefed about them. * **Data\-driven and adaptive thinking.** You make data\-driven calls while embracing the uncertainty earlier\-stage vertical B2B SaaS brings. * **Problem\-solving and communication.** You navigate complexity, distill the key issue, and communicate clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. * **Business sense and a continuous improvement mindset.** Strong business intuition and a real appetite for innovation, iteration, and AI excellence. **Big Plus** ------------ * Complex B2B, enterprise, or ERP\-adjacent software, with high\-frequency users and workflows people can't opt out of. * Agentic products, and the patterns for trust, correction, and handoff between a person and an agent. * Systems\-of\-record or integrations work. You understand how messy real\-world source data becomes a clean, canonical model, and what breaks when it doesn't. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- The target salary range for this role is **$130\-160k salary \+ quarterly bonus and meaningful equity.** Final offers will be based on your skills and previous experience. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) program * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited PTO (and we mean it, we want you to take time off) \+ 10 company\-paid holidays * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave, primary and secondary caregivers, including adoption and fostering * Professional development (get that book, take that course, attend that conference) * Access to the AI tools that make you faster, and encouragement to find new ones * Annual company\-paid offsites * A friendly, inclusive, human\-first team that blends hustle, productivity, and fun Proton.ai is an equal opportunity employer. Proton.ai participates in the E\-Verify program: Notice of E\-Verify Participation, Right to Work.

jobs.title: Executive Director of Facilities - Quinsigamond Community College
jobs.description: **Location:** Worcester, MA **Category:** Executive / Management **Job Type:** Full\-time **Posted On:** Sun Sep 13 2026 **Job Description:** **General Statement** Responsible for overseeing maintenance and repairs of all buildings and land on main campus, including groundskeeping, refuse collection, snow removal, and sidewalks/roadways. Oversees renovations and new construction projects, maintenance and repairs, utilization of space, provision of utilities, and heavy equipment fleet. Provides members of the college community with a reliable and functional physical learning and work environment that supports the college's mission and objectives. **Supervision Received** Reports directly to the Vice President of Finance and Administration/CFO **Supervision Exercised** Supervises multiple shifts of approximately 40 employees comprised of professional staff, project managers, skilled trades, foremen, maintenance personnel, equipment operators, ground workers, and clerical staff **Duties and Responsibilities** * Directs the activities of the Facilities Department, including projects, trades, utilities, custodial, and grounds teams * Leads the planning, design, construction, operations and maintenance of buildings, grounds and infrastructure; facilitates planned/programmed maintenance for all campus facilities * Ensures all facilities meet local, state, and federal regulations (e.g., OSHA, ADA, fire/life safety) and manages emergency response protocols * Provides guidance on facilities matters and interprets departmental programs, policies, and activities to internal and external stakeholders * Provides leadership and direction for the department and the College; works with administration and appropriate committees to identify the College's needs and provides support and recommendations for space allocation * Conducts effective negotiations and represents the College and the department in meetings with regulatory officials and outside organizations; navigates and resolves controversial issues * Oversees design, bid, and construction phases for approved projects, including coordination of projects with and between contractors, architects, engineers, equipment, vendors, and facilities staff; maintains digital blueprints, building plans, and other construction records * Develops code compliant specifications and standards for in\-house projects * Plans, assigns and directs the work of management, supervisory, professional, and technical personnel; accounts for weather, seasonal workloads, scheduled college events and emergencies * Organizes and prioritizes available resources for the maintenance, improvement, and repair of college facilities, infrastructure, and equipment; compiles estimates, contract provisions, and specifications * Monitors changes in laws, regulations, and technology that may affect College or departmental operations; implements policy and procedural changes as required * Oversees all purchasing and procurement procedures for the department * Establishes an operating budget that is responsive to the daily maintenance needs of the college and adequately forecasts funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials, supplies, and critical repairs * Facilitates the procurement and implementation of college maintenance contracts (e.g. emergency generators, plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, maintenance vehicles, and horticultural projects, etc.) * Develops estimates and controls costs for construction and landscape projects * Manages, monitors, and controls campus systems through the Building Management System (BMS) * Supervises and schedules repairs and preventative maintenance for all building systems * Utilizes the state, centralized platform Capital Asset Management Information System (CAMIS) to track preventive/corrective maintenance and manage capital planning, deferred maintenance/critical repairs, and facilities work orders * Supervises the work management system to respond to requests from the College community for facilities services * Serves as the state designated Health and Trenching Safety Officer for the college and performs the required functions * Selects, trains, motivates, and directs department personnel; evaluates and reviews work for acceptability and conformance with department standards, including program and project priorities * Administers the AFSCME collective bargaining agreement in a fair and consistent manner * Supervises scheduling of AFSCME employee overtime assignments * Works actively with other areas of the college to ensure a spirit of college wide collaboration, collegiality, civility, and teamwork. Respects the function of dissent in an academic institution while advancing a collegial atmosphere of campus collaboration. * Embraces the ideals of diversity and inclusiveness and supports the equal rights of all people by advancing the understanding and appreciation of differences including age, race, gender, ability, religious convictions, socio\-economic status, ethnic heritage, or sexual orientation * Provides flexible, responsive and high\-quality service to all, be they students, community, or staff, and continuously assesses processes and procedures and revises accordingly * Performs other duties as assigned **Job Requirements:** **Minimum Qualifications** * 5 years Facilities management experience with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role * Construction/Trades management experience * Knowledge of Massachusetts building codes/OSHA Safety Standards * Deep understanding of MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) and HVAC, systems. * Knowledge of ADA compliance * Knowledge of environmental regulatory requirements * Excellent oral and written communication skills **Preferred Qualifications** * 6\+ years Facilities management experience or bachelor's degree in related field * Engineering or Project Management background * Experience in a unionized environment * Experience with space planning * CAD proficiency * Experience in Higher Education * Building/Energy Management \& automation systems experience * Massachusetts Certified Public Purchasing Official (MCPPO) * Experience with DCAMM (Division of Capital Asset Management and Maintenance) procedures * Experience with CAMIS (Capital Asset Management Information System) or equivalent Facilities Work order system **Additional Information:** Quinsigamond Community College is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, religion, age, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity or sexual orientation in its programs and activities as required by Title IX of the Educational Amendments of 1972, the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, and other applicable statutes and college policies. The College prohibits sexual harassment, including sexual violence. Inquiries or complaints concerning discrimination, harassment, retaliation, or sexual violence shall be referred to the College's Affirmative Action and/or Title IX Coordinator, the Massachusetts Commission against Discrimination, the Equal Employment Opportunities Commission or the United States Department of Education's Office for Civil Rights. We are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive, respectful, and equitable environment for all students, staff, and faculty. Every member on our college campus enriches our diversity. We support inclusion and are dedicated to ensuring equity in access to opportunities. Quinsigamond Community College is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Members of underrepresented groups, minorities, women, veterans, persons with disabilities, and all persons committed to diversity and inclusive excellence are strongly encouraged to apply. Successful applicants will be required to complete a Criminal Offender Record Information (CORI/SORI) request.

jobs.title: Senior Water Resources Engineer / Project Manager
jobs.description: **About RIVUS Consulting** RIVUS Consulting is a certified DBE/SBE/MBE engineering and environmental consulting firm providing innovative solutions to public\-sector clients. Our services span planning, engineering design, environmental permitting, program and construction management, inspection, GIS, asset management, and data systems. Our core technical areas include stormwater, drainage and flood resilience, water resources, transportation infrastructure, environmental compliance, stream restoration, and public works program delivery. RIVUS is continuing to expand its presence in North Texas and is seeking an experienced professional who can combine strong technical and project\-management capabilities with client development and Dallas office leadership. **Position Overview** RIVUS Consulting is seeking a **Senior Water Resources Engineer / Project Manager** to lead hydrology, hydraulics, stormwater, drainage, floodplain, water\-quality, and stream\-restoration projects while helping expand the firm's presence in the Dallas–Fort Worth market. The position will manage feasibility studies, engineering analyses, design documentation, permitting, construction support, and multidisciplinary project teams. The successful candidate should have strong experience with H\&H modeling, drainage infrastructure, floodplain management, watershed studies, MS4/TMDL programs, and public\-sector infrastructure projects. Experience with coastal, resilience, or advanced flood modeling—including tidal, surge, shoreline, or climate\-resilience applications—is desirable. In addition to technical responsibilities, this position will play an important role in **Dallas office management and business development**. The individual will represent RIVUS with clients, teaming partners, professional organizations, and public agencies and help develop a sustainable backlog of work in North Texas. **Key Responsibilities** **Technical and Project Management** * Manage mid\-sized to large\-scale stormwater, drainage, flood\-control, watershed, and water\-resources projects. * Perform and/or oversee hydrologic and hydraulic modeling and engineering analyses. * Lead preparation of feasibility studies, design reports, plans, specifications, cost estimates, and technical memoranda. * Manage floodplain, drainage, stormwater\-quality, stream\-restoration, and MS4\-related assignments. * Coordinate environmental and regulatory permitting. * Provide technical oversight during design and construction. * Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations. * Coordinate multidisciplinary staff, subconsultants, and teaming partners. * Review technical work products and provide QA/QC. * Mentor junior engineers and support their technical and professional development. **Dallas Office Management** * Support the day\-to\-day coordination and growth of RIVUS's Dallas\-area operations. * Help establish an effective local office presence and maintain communication with RIVUS corporate leadership. * Coordinate workloads and assignments for Dallas\-area technical staff. * Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of local staff as the office grows. * Help maintain accountability for project delivery, utilization, schedules, and client commitments. * Assist leadership with identifying staffing and technical resources needed to support the Texas backlog. * Represent RIVUS's culture, professional standards, and commitment to client service in the North Texas market. **Business Development and Client Relations** * Develop and maintain relationships with public\-sector clients, prime consultants, teaming partners, and industry organizations throughout North Texas. * Help identify upcoming opportunities with municipalities, counties, transportation agencies, river authorities, water districts, and other public agencies. * Represent RIVUS at targeted industry meetings, conferences, procurement events, and client meetings. * Develop relationships with larger engineering firms where RIVUS can participate as a DBE/SBE/MBE teaming partner. * Participate in client visits, introductory meetings, project debriefings, and industry networking. * Track procurement forecasts and upcoming solicitations relevant to RIVUS's technical capabilities. * Assist with go/no\-go decisions, teaming strategies, capture planning, and proposal development. * Participate in preparation of statements of qualifications, technical proposals, scopes, fees, and interview presentations. * Help convert RIVUS's Texas certifications and technical capabilities into sustainable project backlog. * Identify cross\-selling opportunities involving water resources, drainage, transportation, structural engineering, environmental services, GIS/data systems, inspection, and program/construction management. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Professional Engineer (PE) license required; Texas PE strongly preferred or ability to obtain Texas registration. * Approximately **10\+ years of progressively responsible experience** in water resources, drainage, stormwater, floodplain, or related civil engineering. * Demonstrated experience managing public\-sector engineering projects. * Strong knowledge of hydrologic and hydraulic modeling. * Experience with commonly used H\&H software such as HEC\-RAS, HEC\-HMS, XP\-SWMM/InfoWorks ICM, SWMM, or comparable platforms. * Experience preparing drainage studies, floodplain analyses, construction plans, specifications, and cost estimates. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to interact effectively with agency staff, clients, teaming partners, contractors, and technical personnel. * Experience developing client relationships, proposals, or new business is strongly preferred. * Existing relationships within the Dallas–Fort Worth engineering/public\-infrastructure market are highly desirable. **Preferred Experience** Experience working with or pursuing opportunities involving organizations such as: * TxDOT * NTTA * NCTCOG * Trinity River Authority * North Texas municipalities and counties * Water districts and river authorities * USACE * FEMA * TCEQ Experience in transportation drainage, bridge/roadway hydraulics, structural coordination, flood mitigation, watershed planning, environmental permitting, utilties, or program/construction management is also desirable. **Leadership Opportunity** This position is intended for an engineer who wants to remain technically engaged while assuming increasing responsibility for **projects, clients, staff, and growth of RIVUS's Dallas operation**. As the North Texas backlog expands, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow into a broader office and regional leadership position. The key change we had made was to make the position **not just a senior technical engineer**, but someone accountable for helping build the Dallas backlog, managing the local office presence, attending industry/client events, and developing relationships with agencies and primes. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Senior Database Developer (SQL & Databricks)
jobs.description: **Summary:** We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Database Developer to design, develop, and optimize data solutions across Microsoft SQL Server and the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. This role will own the stored procedures, database objects, and data\-movement processes that support our enterprise applications. You will partner closely with backend .NET developers to deliver reliable, high\-performing data\-access solutions and help establish Databricks as an enterprise platform for governed data, analytics, and AI/BI. The ideal candidate combines deep SQL Server development expertise with practical experience building data\-platform solutions. This is a hands\-on builder role: you will write production code, solve complex performance and data\-integration challenges, and establish reusable standards and patterns for other engineering teams to follow. **Responsibilities:** **Databricks** * Develop and support solutions using Databricks, including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, notebooks, and workflows. * Help establish catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes, permissions, lineage, and data\-quality standards within Unity Catalog. * Support data movement, ETL/ELT, batch processing, and incremental synchronization using Databricks. * Develop reusable connection patterns, templates, and standards to support Databricks adoption across enterprise applications. * Work with Databricks Lakebase and PostgreSQL to support transactional and operational use cases. * Build and maintain AI/BI Genie spaces using curated enterprise data, including semantic models, instructions, and sample queries. * Troubleshoot Databricks jobs, workflows, data pipelines, and performance issues. **SQL Server and Database Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and other database objects in Microsoft SQL Server. * Write and maintain complex T\-SQL for data movement, system integrations, batch loads, incremental syncs, and application data retrieval. * Tune queries and indexes, analyze execution plans, and resolve blocking, deadlocks, and long\-running jobs. * Manage database schemas, deployment scripts, and versioning of database objects through source control and CI/CD pipelines. * Ensure database code meets standards for data integrity, security, performance, and auditability. * Partner with backend .NET developers to translate application requirements into effective stored procedures and data\-access patterns. * Review queries and data\-access code using Entity Framework, Dapper, ADO.NET, and related technologies. * Participate in sprint planning, technical design reviews, code reviews, and other Agile engineering activities. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify data needs and deliver practical, maintainable solutions. **Qualifications:** * At least one year of hands\-on professional experience developing or supporting Databricks solutions in a production or enterprise environment. * Six or more years of professional experience developing on Microsoft SQL Server, with strong T\-SQL and stored\-procedure experience. * Experience with Databricks Lakehouse technologies, including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, notebooks, and workflows. * Proven experience developing SQL for data movement, ETL/ELT, system integrations, and application data retrieval. * Strong database performance\-tuning skills, including execution plans, indexing, statistics, blocking, deadlocks, and concurrency troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and familiarity with Databricks Lakebase. * Experience collaborating with application developers, preferably in a .NET or C\# environment. * Experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines for database and data\-platform code. * Familiarity with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Knowledge of data governance, row\-level security, column\-level security, data quality, and enterprise compliance requirements. * Experience with AI/BI Genie or similar natural\-language analytics tools is preferred. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions, is a plus. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Highly visible role with a broad engagement within Ross IT and business teams as well as externally with technology providers. Manage the delivery of strategic business, application and technology architecture on projects to deliver desired business outcomes. * Supervise other architects in the development of the architecture (application and technology) roadmap that aligns with the strategic objectives of business units and the different technology groups. * With business or IT partner support, manage competing demands through negotiation and compromise to ensure that the holistic needs of the organization are met. Brings knowledge of Retail industry best practices and applies that information in discussing solutions that may address those needs. * Provide enterprise architecture thought leadership to a cohesive team of solution/ data/ technical architects, external experts and consultants. * Performs business analysis activities at the strategic, operational, and organizational level; working with key partners in the continual improvement of processes within the company. * Takes the leadership role in exploring and analyzing new applications in the marketplace, technology and infrastructure services. * Ensure work produced by the team is aligned with other Enterprise, Application and Portfolio architects, providing holistic enterprise solutions. * Ensure completion of Architectural and project deliverables on time and under budget and that anticipated business outcomes are achieved * Provide architectural and technical input for definition, estimation and delivery of projects * Drive Enterprise Architecture process and evangelize the architecture community of practice. * Leads the development of architecture metrics and reporting to evaluate and communicate the achievement and impact of the Enterprise Architecture function; presents Enterprise Architecture content to internal and external audiences, including cross\-functional executive leadership. ### **COMPETENCIES** Building Effective Teams Developing Talent Collaboration Leading by Example Communicates Effectively Ensures Accountability \& Execution Manages Conflict Business Acumen Plans, Aligns \& Prioritizes Organizational Agility Technical Competence/Expertise Customer Focus Problem Solving Strategic Thinking### **QUALIFICATIONS \& SPECIAL SKILLS REQUIRED** * 10\+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture in Retail industry and 15\+ years combined in delivering IT Technologies, Solution architecture, or systems * Demonstrated Retail Enterprise Architecture experience. Technically competent; able to supervise enterprise architects, solution architects, consultants and external vendor resources * Experience in a variety of application and business architecture areas in Retail domain (Merchandising, Planning, Forecasting, Supply chain,, Stores, Marketing, Digital, etc), SaaS/ Package solutions, Cloud platforms, Business capability modeling, Advanced Analytics, AI/ ML, Gen AI, etc. * A solid understanding of industry best practices in Retail and Ent. Arch – ARTS, NRF models, TOGAF, Archimate etc. * Demonstrated ability to anticipate and handle complex issues, drive negotiations of solutions and to resolve conflicts * Demonstrated 5\+ years of experience in managing a team of enterprise architects, solution architects and consultants. * Demonstrated ability to execute basic financial analysis, such as ROI, and TCO * Strong analytical ability, judgment and problem analysis techniques * Strong communication skills both written and verbal and able to effectively operate with VP and above executives. * Ability to work with teams that are geographically distributed and work across different time zones. * Technically competent; able to supervise and provide leadership to other senior architects * Some travel may be required. ### **EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS** * Undergraduate degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical discipline. Master’s degree is a plus. ### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** Job requires ability to work in an office environment, primarily on a computer Requires sitting, standing, walking, hearing, talking on the telephone, attending in\-person meetings, typing, and working with paper/files, etc Consistent timeliness and regular attendance Vision requirements: Ability to see information in print and/or electronically This role requires regular in\-office presence, including to engage in in\-person team interaction, meetings and collaboration, client support, mentoring, coaching, and/or feedback However, this role can perform duties effectively using a combination of in\-office and remote work### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** Senior Mgr Solution Architects and Engineers **DISCLAIMER** This job description is a summary of the primary duties and responsibilities of the job and position. jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. jobs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI)
jobs.description: **Senior Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI)** ================================================= **Location:** **New York City** =============================== **Why You Should Join Us** -------------------------- Solstice is redefining how life sciences organizations commercialize therapeutics. We are building a commercial engine that allows pharmaceutical marketers to launch campaigns at 100x the speed. Our mission is to accelerate the knowledge of life\-saving medicines. * **Rapid growth:** Over the past year, we have worked with some of the top life sciences manufacturers and over 50\+ pharma brands including Pfizer and AstraZeneca. * **A hard technical problem:** We are trying to rethink the way the largest, most innovative therapies in the world come to market. Every claim in pharma marketing content must trace to an approved source. Fair balance rules govern placement. All materials go through rigorous medical, legal, and regulatory review, which can last months. Building persuasive and defensible content is a genuine challenge, with no playbook. We have the customers and proprietary data to do this right. * **Top\-tier investors:** Our backers include Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm. * **Influence and ownership:** This senior role directly shapes our architectural future. We're seeking someone who wants responsibility, not someone who needs work handed to them. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a senior Applied AI engineer to own the technical direction of our AI systems: retrieval, generation, verification, evaluation, and keeping systems running in production. Nothing's predetermined. When there's a fork in the road, you decide. You will work closely with VP of Engineering Jay, and co\-founders Aris and Yiwen, influencing product strategy, technical hiring, and our market positioning. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * **High\-craft output:** Our clients demand work with polish, not "AI slop." Pharma assets like emails, banners, slides and leave\-behinds require both visual and textual excellence. ISI must be prominent, brand systems must endure, and hierarchy and typography must survive generation. Our job isn't just compliance. It's making sure assets don't get quietly rewritten by marketers. * **Connecting content to outcomes:** Passing MLR review means a piece can ship, but not that it worked. We'll connect generated assets to real\-world performance, including engagement, HCP response and scripts written, and use that data to improve future output. * **Evaluation where ground truth is slow:** Determining compliance is slow, coming back as reviewer redlines in inconsistent formats. Developing offline metrics that track downstream MLR pass rate is critical. * **Claim\-level attribution:** True grounding means every sentence can be traced back to a specific, defensible source. Our proprietary corpora span prescribing information, clinical data, approved assets, style guides and claim libraries, and provenance must be preserved through generation. * **ML Ops and behavioral regression:** Full CI/CD for ML, versioning, automated testing, monitoring, and the harder under\-the\-hood work. Your responsibility is to make sure the complete player experience ships correctly and on time, not simply to update Jira or report status. You will work closely with the product leadership in Los Angeles while coordinating execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing. For major live events, platform featuring opportunities, content updates, and releases, you will be the person making sure every function is aligned, dependencies are visible, risks are surfaced early, and nothing falls between teams. **What You Will Own** ===================== **End\-to\-End Launch \& Release Ownership** -------------------------------------------- * Own production for major live events, features, content updates, platform promotions, and releases from approved concept through launch and post\-launch verification. * Build launch plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, content locks, QA windows, release candidates, and go/no\-go checkpoints. * Make sure Product, Engineering, Art, Narrative, QA, Localization, Marketing, and platform requirements come together as one coherent launch. * Surface risks early and drive tradeoff discussions with the appropriate product, creative, and functional owners. **Turn Designs Into Executable Production Plans** ------------------------------------------------- * Ensure approved design/product specifications are current, complete, and treated as the single source of truth. * Translate initiatives into clear Jira epics, tasks, owners, dependencies, and deadlines; partner with functional owners to refine technical and discipline\-specific subtasks. * Make sure Engineering and QA are never expected to implement or test from outdated Slack messages or ambiguous documentation. * Establish and enforce practical standards for design handoff, task readiness, change tracking, and acceptance criteria. **Cross\-Functional \& LA–Beijing Production** ---------------------------------------------- * Coordinate production between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing, keeping priorities, dependencies, handoffs, and deadlines aligned across time zones. * Create enough overlap and communication structure that issues spanning TapBlaze and our publishing partner are resolved without depending on the CEO to connect the pieces. * Partner with team members and functional leads at TapBlaze and our publishing partner to clarify ownership, escalate blockers, and improve accountability. * Be comfortable working across cultures and time zones; Mandarin and/or prior China/APAC game\-development experience is a strong plus. **QA, Localization \& Release Readiness** ----------------------------------------- * Ensure QA coverage, test planning, regression scope, release\-candidate timing, and critical launch coverage are planned before they become emergencies. * Make localization part of the production plan from the beginning, including source\-string completeness, deadlines, implementation, and verification. * Run lightweight launch\-readiness reviews for important releases and make unresolved risks explicit before launch. * Ensure post\-release smoke testing and verification are assigned and completed. **Production Systems \& Continuous Improvement** ------------------------------------------------ * Build simple, scalable production processes that improve clarity and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. * Own Jira and production documentation as tools for execution—not as ends in themselves. * Run postmortems when launches or processes break down, identify root causes, and turn lessons into durable process improvements. * Develop clear escalation paths and operating rhythms for live games, including major releases and critical incidents. **You’re a Great Fit If ...** ============================= * You have 5\+ years of game production experience, including meaningful ownership of shipped or live\-operated games. * You have strong experience with mobile f2p live games, recurring content, live ops, or similarly fast release environments. * You have led cross\-functional production across multiple disciplines rather than only managing schedules for a single team. * You are highly organized, but your value is judgment and ownership, not just task administration and coordination. We are not looking for project manager type producers. * You naturally ask what is missing, who owns it, what can block launch, and what needs to happen next. * You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, incomplete handoffs, unrealistic schedules, and unowned dependencies. * You can operate effectively in a small, hands\-on studio where leaders are expected to solve problems rather than pass them between departments. * Production experience with distributed teams, co\-development partners, or publishers is strongly preferred. * Experience working with teams in China or APAC is strongly preferred; Mandarin is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Major launches have a clearly accountable owner, current source\-of\-truth documentation, complete Jira execution plans, task owners, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints. * Product, Engineering, QA, Localization, and Marketing are aligned before release rather than discovering conflicts at the end. * Cross\-time\-zone execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing becomes predictable and transparent. * Problems are surfaced and resolved by the production organization before they need CEO intervention. * The team learns from misses and improves the system so the same failure does not recur. **How We Work** =============== This is a full\-time, five\-day\-per\-week in\-office position at TapBlaze’s Los Angeles studio, with no remote or hybrid option. We believe this role is most effective when deeply embedded with the team and able to resolve issues quickly in person. We believe *beauty is in the details*. If you have read this far, include that phrase somewhere in your application. **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Los Angeles, CA: Reliably commute or relocate before starting work; * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. **Compensation** ================ The range for this role is $100,000 to $125,000 depending on experience, with the opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. **Commitment to Diversity** =========================== As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, TAPBLAZE recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is integral to our success. We hire talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion within our company and across interactions with vendors and partners. Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact careers@tapblaze.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice

Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well\-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits. **PRINCIPAL ENGINEER – AI PLATFORMS** **About Us** Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. Target's AI Platform organization is building the next generation of enterprise AI capabilities that enable teams to develop, deploy, govern, and operate Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions at scale. Our platform powers AI innovation across the enterprise by providing secure, scalable, and reusable capabilities that accelerate development while maintaining enterprise standards for reliability, governance, and operational excellence. As a Principal Engineer – ML Operations Platform, you will provide technical leadership in defining the architecture and evolution of our enterprise machine learning platform.
